This role involves coordinating the testing of samples, sharing data by entering results into a computer application, and helping ensure some basic data interpretation is completed accurately. You will work with others to maintain good laboratory practices and support the team's testing goals.

Wet Chemistry techniques
HPLC / GC testing and/or data

Attention to detail
Well organized
Good laboratory skills, preferably in pharma/biotech
Experience operating analytical equipment preferred (analytical balance, total carbon analyzer, spectrophotometer, pH meter)
